feature_flag_key.description: Unique key for the experiment's feature flag. Letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only. Search existing flags with the feature-flag-get-all tool first — reuse an existing flag when possible.

id.description: A unique integer value identifying this experiment.

repository.description: GitHub repository holding this experiment's feature-flag code, in `organization/repository` format. Used as the target of the flag-cleanup pull request opened via open_cleanup_pr on end/ship_variant. When not set, cleanup targets the team's only connected repository and is skipped if the team has several.
